title: As a system user, I should be able to get the detailed NCM compliance reports
description:
Figma:
 
[https://www.figma.com/proto/bdEt4lwQK4DidvwMJHxsJ3/Reports?page-id=0%3A1&node-id=4685-48025&viewport=-25033%2C-54159%2C1.38&scaling=scale-down-width&starting-point-node-id=619%3A22812&content-scaling=fixed&t=mf9gomkvYodr0oXS-1&hide-ui=1] 
 
 
Acceptance Criteria:  
 
 
- I should be able to see the reports under the NCM tab in the Reports section. 
- I should be able to see all the reports by clicking on the new category called "Compliance". 
- I should be able to see the executive summary report as shown in Figma. 
- I should be able to see the audit policy report as shown in Figma. 
- I should have a per-device compliance summary report which should only be downloaded from the pdf icon given in the per-device compliance screen. 
- I should be able to download the same report from the export pdf button given in the NCM compliance tab.

 

Note:

- PFA PDF format for the respective reports. These PDFs are for representation purposes. If the length exceeds, pagination should be added to these PDFs.
attachments: NCM Compliance Audit Policies Performance Report.pdf

comments.author: Bharat Chaudhari
comments.body:
As the approach has been finalized, we will maintain {*}separate HTML templates for each fix and for complex reports like this{*}. Initially, we attempted a generic approach and completed a POC, but it proved to be too complex for the compliance report. This is mainly because it requires extensive manual calculations on raw data, and there is no direct support for the exact data representation we need. Due to these constraints, a more *static and tightly coupled approach* is more suitable for this implementation.

Going forward, we will have {*}three different plugins{*}, one for each type of NCCM compliance report. Each plugin will have its *own dedicated HTML template* and its {*}own set of required widgets{*}. Based on the data received from these widgets, the necessary logic will be implemented within the respective plugin.

Given the scope and changes involved, this implementation will be {*}moved to the next sprint{*}.

cc : [~chaitas.shah] [~jenil.kajavadara] [~keertan.zala]
